title: 162. Majority Element II

examples.explanation: 3 appears twice, which is more than 3/3 = 1.
A single element trivially appears more than 1/3 times.
Both 1 and 2 appear once, which is more than 2/3.

hints: At most two elements can appear more than n/3 times.
Extended Boyer-Moore with two candidates and counts finds them in O(n) time and O(1) space, followed by a verification pass.
